verdict.rationale: gstack has agent-runnable install-adjacent flows. The /gstack-upgrade skill detects global vs vendored installs and runs the upgrade, with a GSTACK_AUTO_UPGRADE switch for promptless upgrades. Agents can also save domain skills themselves and promote them to global, after which future sessions pick them up automatically. However, no documented non-interactive initial install command exists for a coding agent to run headlessly; the community describes the install as git-clone-and-copy. Missing for 10: a documented promptless, headless first-time skill install path; explicit non-interactive flags or exit behavior; hands-on corroboration of an agent completing an install end to end.
